bundle.description: Topo, 1.5 m satellite imagery, 30 m relief and contours, forest stands inferred from the national forest maps, burns, water, game management subzones, First Nation settlement land, and the habitat, wind and going grids around Highland Lake; no 1 m LiDAR here.

forest.attribution: Forest inferred from SCANFI and CanLaD © Natural Resources Canada

basemap.missing: not baked: the map draws the live NRCan base map

topo.source: Toporama hypsography (contours and spot heights), NRCan WMS

satellite.source: Yukon SPOT 1.5 m colour composite, Geomatics Yukon ImageServer

hillshadeLidar.source: ArcticDEM 2 m mosaic v4.1 (a satellite-stereo surface model, voids filled from the MRDEM), Polar Geospatial Center
hillshadeLidar.licence: ArcticDEM: free, cite PGC (NSF OPP awards)
hillshadeLidar.note: ArcticDEM 2 m (with the MRDEM in its voids) over 100% of the core

dem.source: MRDEM 30 m, NRCan, with ArcticDEM 2 m mosaic v4.1 (a satellite-stereo surface model, voids filled from the MRDEM), Polar Geospatial Center over the core

contours.source: ArcticDEM 2 m mosaic v4.1 (a satellite-stereo surface model, voids filled from the MRDEM), Polar Geospatial Center
contours.licence: ArcticDEM: free, cite PGC (NSF OPP awards)

forest.source: inferred from SCANFI v2 (species, closure, height, age, 30 m) and CanLaD v1.1 (cuts and burns), Canadian Forest Service

understory.source: The area's own bush model (bush/local.py, docs/BUSH-MODEL.md): open, low shrub, tall bush or dense trees at 10 m from Sentinel-2 seasons, PALSAR, SCANFI, CanLaD and the MRDEM, learned from 164 labels tapped on the photo; held out a patch at a time, 71% right and thick-or-not 85%; faded where it is unsure. Modelled, not measured
understory.licence: Copernicus Sentinel data; JAXA ALOS PALSAR mosaic (free, attribution); OGL-Canada; CanLaD CC BY 4.0

lanes.source: The shooting lanes from the area's own bush model at 10 m (bush/local.py): open and light ground clear, thicker bush shaded darker; learned from 164 labels tapped on the photo. Modelled, not measured
lanes.licence: Copernicus Sentinel data; JAXA ALOS PALSAR mosaic (free, attribution); OGL-Canada; CanLaD CC BY 4.0

habitat.source: derived: MRDEM, NRCan 2020 land cover, forest stands, water, wetlands, roads and burns

micro.source: derived: the habitat grid and the MRDEM

going.source: derived: HRDEM LiDAR, point-cloud bush or the forest-map estimate, water, wetlands and roads

treeline.from: the 98th percentile of the treed cells' elevation in the habitat grid; 13% of the land is above it, 82% of that open
